edges.reason: Fern patch is directly adjacent to the dandelion meadow; finding dandelions orients player to nearby ferns
Ice spikes zone is east of the dandelion meadow; dandelion area serves as starting orientation point
Pink terracotta blocks are placed at the base of the ice spike structures; must locate ice spikes first
Soul lantern pathway begins south of the dandelion spawn area leading to the trading station
The fletcher trading station is at the end of the soul lantern-lit pathway; lanterns guide player to merchant
The ladder tower is visible west of the dandelion meadow; dandelion marks the starting navigation hub
The potted red tulip is on an elevated platform only accessible by climbing the ladder
The bow, arrows, and chicken target are on the elevated platform reached via the ladder
Acacia stairs shelter is southwest of the dandelion meadow; visible from the central spawn area
The tamed cat is confined in a fenced pen inside the acacia stairs shelter
